model: Claude Code agent mode, fresh subagent

steps.start: the center line of Highway 99 at its junction with the easterly boundary of the Resort Municipality of Whistler
steps.until: its intersection with the 1 200 m contour line immediately east of Nineteen Mile Creek
steps.quote: Commencing at the center line of Highway 99 at its junction with the easterly boundary of the Resort Municipality of Whistler, hereinafter referred to as Whistler, and proceeding in a northerly and westerly direction along the boundary of Whistler to its intersection with the 1 200 m contour line immediately east of Nineteen Mile Creek

steps.until: a point on the contour line, above Sixteen Mile Creek, at the junction of the easterly and southerly slopes of Rainbow Mountain
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the contour line approximately 2 km to a point on the contour line, above Sixteen Mile Creek, at the junction of the easterly and southerly slopes of Rainbow Mountain
thence due northeast in a straight line across Sixteen Mile Creek to the 1 050 m contour line

steps.until: a point due West of the intersection of the power line and Highway 99 approximately 3 km northeast of the point of commencement
steps.quote: thence easterly and northerly along the contour line to a point due West of the intersection of the power line and Highway 99 approximately 3 km northeast of the point of commencement
thence due East to that intersection

steps.until: a point due North of the junction of Rethel Creek and the Green River
steps.quote: thence along the southerly and the easterly boundary of Highway 99 to a point due North of the junction of Rethel Creek and the Green River

steps.until: its intersection with the boundary of Garibaldi Provincial Park
steps.quote: thence across the Green River and up the northern and eastern natural boundary of Rethel Creek to its intersection with the boundary of Garibaldi Provincial Park

steps.until: its intersection with the eastern boundary of Whistler
steps.quote: thence westerly along the boundary of the park to its intersection with the eastern boundary of Whistler
thence northerly and easterly and northerly along the boundary of Whistler to the point of commencement

steps.start: the southwest corner of the Brandywine Falls Provincial Park boundary
steps.quote: Commencing at the southwest corner of the Brandywine Falls Provincial Park boundary
thence due West up the slope of Mount Brew to the 3 000 ft. (900 m) contour line

steps.until: the point of its intersection with the unnamed creek originating at Brew Lake
steps.quote: thence in a southerly direction along that contour line to the point of its intersection with the unnamed creek originating at Brew Lake

steps.feature: unnamed creek originating at Brew Lake
steps.until: the confluence of the unnamed creek with Roe Creek
steps.quote: thence in a southerly direction downstream to the confluence of the unnamed creek with Roe Creek

steps.until: the mouth of Roe Creek at Shadow Lake
steps.quote: thence in an easterly direction, downstream to the mouth of Roe Creek at Shadow Lake

steps.side_or_bank: high water mark of the northerly shore
steps.until: the point of intersection of the high water mark with a perpendicular, downward projection of the centerline of Highway 99 from the center of the Highway 99 bridge across the connecting waterway between Daisy Lake and Shadow Lake
steps.quote: thence in an easterly direction, along the high water mark of the northerly shore of Shadow Lake to the point of intersection of the high water mark with a perpendicular, downward projection of the centerline of Highway 99 from the center of the Highway 99 bridge across the connecting waterway between Daisy Lake and Shadow Lake

steps.until: the point of intersection with Brandywine Falls Provincial Park boundary
steps.quote: thence northerly along the centerline of Highway 99 to the point of intersection with Brandywine Falls Provincial Park boundary

steps.until: the southwest corner of Brandywine Falls Provincial Park, being the point of commencement
steps.quote: thence westerly along the southern boundary of Brandywine Falls Provincial Park to the southwest corner of Brandywine Falls Provincial Park, being the point of commencement
